lastCompletedStory.title: Stop cam next from injecting the worker task prompt; flip active:true only

nextStoryContext: US-001 removed sendKeysWhenIdle, DEFAULT_TASK_PROMPT, capturePaneFn, idleTimeoutMs, and taskPrompt from src/commands/next.ts. The sidecar (host.ts:229) is now the sole holder of the worker prompt literal. The liveness precondition (hasSession + orchestratorAlive) and the paneCountMutex guard are preserved in next.ts. Test neutralizations: result.test.ts uses a literal prompt; next.test.ts drops the send-keys and DEFAULT_TASK_PROMPT assertions. No US-002 story was started.
